stem.en: The field of view of a microscope is 4 mm wide. Exactly 20 cells fit across it in a line. What is the width of one cell, in micrometres? (1 mm = 1000 micrometres)

explanation.en: 4 mm is 4000 micrometres. Dividing by 20 cells gives 200 micrometres for one cell.

hints.en: Then divide by the number of cells.
